next_session_suggestions: Start implementation with the DB schema/migrations (item_categories, items, recipes, recipe_inputs) since every backend endpoint depends on it.

tasks.title: Design recipe data model
tasks.description: Design the item_categories / items / recipes / recipe_inputs schema covering manufacturing, PI, and reaction recipes uniformly.
tasks.notes: See key_decisions in goal.json for the finalized schema.

tasks.title: Define recipe API endpoints (queries + usecases)
tasks.description: Define GET query endpoints and POST/PATCH/DELETE usecase endpoints for item_categories, recipe_types, items (incl. resolve-by-name), and recipes.
tasks.notes: See key_decisions in goal.json for the full endpoint list and the resolve-by-name flow.

tasks.title: Design frontend pages/navigation for recipe management
tasks.description: Design the Recipe List, Recipe Form, and Categories pages, plus the manual item-name resolve UX.
tasks.notes: See key_decisions in goal.json for page layouts and the manual 'Check Items' resolve trigger decision.

tasks.title: Implement DB schema/migrations
tasks.description: Create the item_categories, items, recipes, and recipe_inputs tables per the finalized data model.

tasks.title: Implement recipe_type single source of truth + GET /recipe-types
tasks.description: Add the backend config file listing recipe types (t1_industry, t2_industry, reaction, pi) and a GET /recipe-types endpoint that serves it; POST /recipes validation reads from the same file.

tasks.title: Implement item_categories endpoints
tasks.description: GET /item-categories, POST /item-categories, PATCH /item-categories/{id}, DELETE /item-categories/{id} (reject delete if a category is still referenced by an item).

tasks.title: Implement items endpoints incl. resolve-by-name
tasks.description: GET /items (filter by category_id + name search), GET /items/{id}, POST /items, PATCH /items/{id}, DELETE /items/{id} (reject if referenced by any recipe), GET /items/{id}/recipes, and POST /items/resolve (batch name lookup returning matched/unmatched).

tasks.title: Implement recipes endpoints
tasks.description: GET /recipes (filter by recipe_type, product category_id, product name search), GET /recipes/{id} (incl. inputs), POST /recipes, PATCH /recipes/{id} (inputs replaced wholesale), DELETE /recipes/{id}. Enforce the multi-recipe rule: allowed if recipe_type is t2_industry, otherwise reject if a recipe already exists for that product.

tasks.title: Implement frontend Recipe List page
tasks.description: Table of recipes with recipe_type/category/name-search filters, Edit/Delete row actions, and a 'New Recipe' entry point.

tasks.title: Implement frontend Recipe Form
tasks.description: Shared create/edit form: recipe_type dropdown, product/input name fields with quantities, manual 'Check Items' resolve button, inline category picker + create button for unmatched items, and Save wired to POST/PATCH /recipes.

tasks.title: Implement frontend Categories page
tasks.description: List item_categories with inline rename, delete (surfacing the backend's in-use rejection), and a 'New Category' input.

tasks.title: End-to-end test with example recipes
tasks.description: Enter the Robotics and Tungsten Carbide example recipes through the app and confirm they persist across a restart.
